A grand stage where only Umamusume 
possessing both popularity and skill may 
compete... the Arima Kinen. What awaited 
there was—

Loud cheers from the crowd and the usual 
faces she never expected to see.

It is a grand gathering of the "Golden 
Generation."

Letting out a sigh, King Halo psyched 
herself up again, resolving to turn every 
single one of them into her backup 
dancers.
